story.introBody: The Great Starlight Beacon has fallen asleep! Walk the paths with Pip the Owl, help the magical friends of each region, and cast learning spells to restore the kingdom's light.
story.restoredBody: You awakened the Whispering Woods, lit the Crystal Caves, restored the Enchanted Library, and crowned Starfall Tower with light!
story.endingSubtitle: Every lantern, crystal, storybook, and star in Moonwood is glowing thanks to you!
story.endingFriends: Your companions Pip, Moss, Bramble, Luma, and Astra dance beneath the restored constellations.

map.heading: Choose a quest
map.heroStatus: Apprentice Aria & Pip · Use Arrow keys or tap the map to explore!

pip.name: Pip the Owl
pip.greeting: Hoo-hoo! Tap any glowing path or ask me whenever you want a helpful clue!

moss.name: Moss the Forest Sprite
moss.greeting: The forest flowers hum when we combine blue and gold mana crystals together!

bramble.name: Bramble the Crystal Mole
bramble.greeting: Down in the Crystal Caves, we pack gems into neat bags of ten so we never lose count!

luma.name: Luma the Librarian Fox
luma.greeting: Every plank on the bridge and every word in our storybooks holds a wonderful secret!

astra.name: Astra the Starlight Sprite
astra.greeting: Look up at the stars! Shapes and number patterns show how the constellations dance!

forestGate.title: The Whispering Gate
forestGate.intro: The gate is asleep. Wake each rune with the right amount of mana!

lanternBridge.title: The Lantern Brook
lanternBridge.intro: Help Moss light the stepping lanterns across the brook by combining glowing mana!

mossGrove.title: The Heartwood Tree
mossGrove.intro: Share sun-drops and star-berries with the sleepy creatures to wake the Heartwood Tree!

crystalCaves.title: Crystal Caves
crystalCaves.intro: Pack crystals into rune bags of ten.

echoForge.title: The Echo Minecart
echoForge.intro: Help Bramble cool the crystal forge by removing the crystals used in each spell!

prismSanctum.title: The Prism Vault
prismSanctum.intro: Count the ten-packs and remaining crystals to open Bramble's glowing Prism Vault!

ravineBridge.title: The Ravine Bridge
ravineBridge.intro: Find planks long enough to cross.

enchantedLibrary.title: The Enchanted Library
enchantedLibrary.intro: Help Luma match sounds and words to return the floating story pages to their books!

livingStorybook.title: The Living Storybook
livingStorybook.intro: Read the magical clues and measure the golden ribbons to wake the Living Storybook!

sigilTemple.title: Sigil Temple
sigilTemple.intro: Build the ancient shapes to open the doors.

starObservatory.title: The Starlight Astrolabe
starObservatory.intro: Help Astra follow the glowing star patterns to align the great telescope!

starfallCrown.title: The Crown of Moonwood
starfallCrown.intro: Use all your magic—numbers, tens, words, shapes, and patterns—to relight the Great Starlight Beacon!
